high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky is a mix of light blue and pastel pink and orange clouds, suggesting a tranquil and peaceful atmosphere. In the foreground, there is lush green vegetation, including grasses and small shrubs, which frame the view of the beach and ocean. A prominent pine tree stands in the center, adding a natural focal point to the composition. The beach itself is sandy with gentle waves lapping at its shore.
